name: Teams
description: Reads your Teams mentions and 1:1 messages into Zeff from Teams in the account's automation Chrome — its own cache, read-only. Replies are sent through the same scraper. Its scraper is a lambda you (or the AI) can mend when Teams changes. (Reading Teams through Microsoft's API with your sign-in is still Zeff's — switch only when it is the automation Chrome.)
author: Zeff
